approved_text: Most measured proportions sit in a typical range. Maintain consistent lighting and a front-facing pose for tracking.
For clearer before/after comparisons, use even daylight, a clean lens, and the same camera distance each time.
Uneven lighting can exaggerate shadows and skew readings. Retake facing a window or soft front light without harsh side shadows.
A slight head turn can change measured proportions. Retake centered to the camera with eyes level and chin parallel to the floor.
Left–right alignment shows elevated asymmetry. Retake with face centered and even lighting before drawing styling conclusions.
Face width relative to height reads below your typical band. Soft volume at the sides of the hair can balance a longer vertical look in photos.
Face width relative to height reads above your typical band. Lengthening styles or center-part framing can refine the silhouette in photos.
Midface length reads below your typical band. Soft highlight on the cheekbones can add lift and openness in makeup applications.
Midface length reads above your typical band. Contouring just under the cheekbones can shorten the midface visually in photos.
Lower face length reads below your typical band. Keeping bangs shorter or swept up can open the lower third visually.
Lower face length reads above your typical band. Soft fringe or volume at mid-length hair can balance a longer lower third in photos.
Jaw width sits below the typical band. Soft contour along the jawline and side hair density can add visual structure in photos.
Jaw width sits above the typical band. Hairstyles with volume at the crown often balance a stronger jaw visually.
Jaw angle reads softer than your typical band. A defined makeup contour at the mandibular corner can sharpen the outline in photos.
Jaw angle reads sharper than your typical band. Diffused contour and softer hair near the jaw can ease the edge in photos.
Chin length reads below your typical band. A soft highlight on the chin tip can add projection for photos.
Chin length reads above your typical band. Soft matte contour under the chin tip can shorten the look in photos.
Chin width reads narrower than your typical band. Horizontal highlight across the chin can widen the tip visually.
Chin width reads wider than your typical band. Narrower vertical highlight and soft side contour can refine the tip in photos.
Cheekbone width reads below your typical band. Highlight placed on the high cheek can lift and widen the midface visually.
Cheekbone width reads above your typical band. Soft contour beneath the zygomatic arch can slim the midface in photos.
Lower cheek fullness reads below your typical band. Warm blush placed slightly lower on the cheek can add soft volume.
Lower cheek fullness reads above your typical band. Blush set higher toward the cheekbone can lift attention away from heaviness.
Eye openness reads below your typical band. Soft nude lid and lifted outer corner liner can open the eye in makeup.
Eye openness reads above your typical band. Softened crease definition can balance a very open eye look in photos.
Eye size relative to face width reads below your typical band. Light shimmer on the center lid can enlarge the look in photos.
Eye size relative to face width reads above your typical band. Softer brow and lid contrast can keep the focus balanced.
Eye spacing reads slightly close. Highlighting the outer eye corners can balance the look in makeup applications.
Eye spacing reads wider than your typical band. Soft emphasis near the inner corners can draw features slightly closer visually.
Eye tilt reads flatter than your typical band. A gentle upward wing at the outer corner can lift the eye line in makeup.
Eye tilt reads more angled than your typical band. Softening the outer wing keeps the gaze from reading overly dramatic in photos.
Brow height reads lower than your typical band. Soft highlight under the arch can lift the brow visually.
Brow height reads higher than your typical band. Keeping brows softly filled without rising too high at the tail balances the forehead.
Brow tilt reads flatter than your typical band. A slight lift at the outer third of the brow can refine the frame.
Brow tilt reads steeper than your typical band. Softening the outer brow angle can ease a sharp lift in photos.
Nose width reads below your typical band. Soft diffuse highlight on the bridge can avoid over-narrowing the look in photos.
Nose width reads above your population band. Soft contouring along the nasal sidewalls can create a narrower visual line in photos.
Nose length reads below your typical band. A slender bridge highlight can lengthen the nose visually in makeup.
Nose length reads above your typical band. Soft matte at the tip and shorter bridge highlight can shorten the look in photos.
Nose tip alignment reads off midline more than your typical band. Retake front-facing with even light before styling decisions.
Mouth width reads below your typical band. Extending lip liner slightly at the corners can widen the smile line in photos.
Mouth width reads above the typical band. Softer lip liner that stays inside the natural corner can refine the look in photos.
Mouth corner tilt reads downward relative to your typical band. A subtle outer-corner lift with liner can brighten the smile line.
Mouth corner tilt reads upward relative to your typical band. Even lip definition keeps the expression reading natural in photos.
Lip thickness is below the typical band. Lip-focused makeup with liner and gloss can enhance perceived fullness.
Lip thickness reads above your typical band. Matte finishes and staying inside the natural border can refine the look in photos.
Upper lip vermilion reads below your typical band. Emphasizing the cupid’s bow with soft liner can balance the upper lip.
Upper lip vermilion reads above your typical band. Soft even color without over-lining the bow keeps proportions balanced.
Philtrum length reads below your typical band. Soft matte under the nose and a defined upper lip border can balance the area visually.
Philtrum length reads above your typical band. Highlight on the upper lip center can shorten the space visually in photos.
